description: Propose a feature contract from sample pricing requests: nested objects are flattened by path, lists reduced to counts, sums, maxima and has-value flags, numbers binned, and fields that identify someone left out, each with the reason. Nothing is stored; save the result with set_feature_contract. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.

buckets.description: Bins for each number, at its quantiles. Default 4.

min_coverage.description: Share of samples a field must appear in. Default 0.05.

opt_in.description: The customer segment and geo fields are used only when listed here, as in buyer-aware pricing.

samples.description: Sample request contexts, as sent to compute_price in context, metadata included. Not stored.

name: infer_feature_contract
